answer.answer: Across the 22 Weser stations with paired counts, the small (11-500 µm) particle concentration exceeds the large (500-5000 µm) concentration by a median factor of about 5236 (interquartile spread spans roughly 700– 40,000, so the typical magnitude is highly variable).
